card.name: Scattered words before a continuing phrase
card.fires_on: Fires on the last digit of a year in blog post dates (200<<7>>, 201<<1>>). Also fires on small linking words such as the, from, of, similar, products after a noun phrase, where a list or qualifier continues.

modes.label: Linking word mid-phrase
modes.description: A small word like the, of, from or products that leads into a qualifying phrase such as a group of people or a family of things.
modes.example: Avoid concomitant use of grapefruit, starfruit and<< products>> containing these fruits, and Seville oranges
